textTemplates.description: Stores the body text for an email sent to a facility requesting that they confirm bed availability for a referral. To customize the email sent requesting confirmation of bed availability for a referral, update the body text here.
textTemplates.name: ConfirmBedAvailabilityEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
{!IterateOverContactPointEmails.Name},


We request that you confirm bed availability for a referral request to your facility 


Please take a few minutes to complete the Confirm Bed Availability for Referral Request Form.


Your responses are protected and kept confidential. You can learn more about how we securely handle your protected health information in our HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices.


Thank you,

{!$Organization.Name}

textTemplates.description: Stores the body of the email notifying the running user that a data base action error has occurred in the flow.
textTemplates.name: DataBaseActionErrorEmaiBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hi, {!$User.FirstName}:


We couldn't {!ErrorActionType} the {!ErrorRecordType} record.


Error: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

textTemplates.name: GeneralErrorEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hi, {!$User.FirstName}


We couldn’t {!ErrorActionType} {!ErrorRecordType} related to these accounts:


{!healthcareFacilityAccountIds}


Try again later.

textTemplates.name: UncontactedFacilitiesEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
{!$User.FirstName},


We couldn't find contact emails for the following account IDs:


{!UnprocessedAccountIds}

textTemplates.description: Stores the body text for an email sent to a facility requesting that they update the bed availability count for their facility. To customize the email sent requesting a bed availability count, update the body text here.
textTemplates.name: UpdateBedCountEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
{!IterateOverContactPointEmails.Name},


Your provider has requested that you update the available bed count for your facility.


Please take a few minutes to complete the Update Available Bed Count Form.


Your responses are protected and kept confidential. You can learn more about how we securely handle your protected health information in our HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices.


Thank you,

{!$Organization.Name}
